title: Concept: Event data in a workflow expression via run: echo "${{ github.event.issue.title }}" (github-actions) — review required
description: In github-actions, run: echo "${{ github.event.issue.title }}" injects event fields into the workflow text. Values such as issue titles and branch names are controlled by whoever opens the issue or pull request, and the runner expands the expression before the shell sees it, so quoting does not help. Route the value through an environment variable (env: TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}).
applicability: github-actions workflow files under .github/workflows; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Command execution on the runner with its token; HIGH severity.
